matchData.veto:
1. Chinggis Warriors removed Dust2
2. Lynn Vision removed Mirage
3. Chinggis Warriors picked Inferno
4. Lynn Vision picked Nuke
5. Lynn Vision removed Anubis
6. Chinggis Warriors removed Train
7. Ancient was left over
